summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-atlas@4.0.8 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, then invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable strings. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library for ServiceTitan's Atlas chat (README documents only React component imports such as `ChatWindow`); neither the Bun runtime fetch, setup.mjs, nor math_init.js is mentioned in the README, and none of this behavior relates to the stated UI-component purpose. Using an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload at preinstall time evades Node-based static review of what runs on the installer's machine. The scoped `@servicetitan` publisher does not change the on-install behavior of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
